If the tenderer has offered GPS-system in its tender, Natural Resources Institute Finland will indicate whether it will purchase the offered GPS system at the beginning of the agreement period. AGREEMENT PERIOD AND DELIVERY SCHEDULE The supplies shall be delivered as described in section 8 "Delivery and Acceptance of the Supplies" of the Appendix A "Agreement".
